sections.heading: Context & The Vision
sections.label: The Brief
body: Bhagyam Arts & Aesthetic stages cultural programmes that bring classical and contemporary performance to new audiences. Each programme needed promotional material that did more than announce a date and a venue: it had to carry the mood of the performance itself.

Studio 1947 designed the promotional campaigns for these programmes, with visual storytelling at the centre: posters, invitations and social creatives that give each event an artistic identity of its own.

media.alt: Madly in Love: promotional cover for a Bhagyam Arts programme, a dancer in gold jewellery against a carved jali screen

sections.heading: What the Client Said
body: "Studio 1947 delivered exceptional promotional designs for our cultural programmes. Their unique emphasis on visual storytelling added a fascinating, artistic layer to our work that we hadn't seen before." — Suranya Aiyar, CEO, Bhagyam Arts & Aesthetic
